title: Voice and Siri · 0.6.0
description: Talk to Lumen instead of typing, hear replies read aloud, and start chats from Siri and Shortcuts.
notes: Tap the microphone in an empty message box and speak: your words appear as you talk. Tap it again to stop. Speech is turned into text on your iPhone.
Read aloud: the speaker button under a reply reads it in your iPhone's voice, without Markdown symbols. Tap it again to stop.
Siri and Shortcuts: say “Ask Lumen” to send a question in a new chat, “Talk to Lumen” to start a chat by voice, or “New Lumen chat”. They're also in the Shortcuts app.
Links that start with lumen://new?prompt= open a new chat with that message filled in, ready for you to send.
